author: 0w3n6325
content:
We haven't yet decided between 1 and 2. 

We are very much in favour of trying to do what we can to bring slot times down. The quick slots EIP is one of our S tier EIPs for Hegota.

But the risks involved in releasing early, before we have a good estimate of what the attestation count is going to be, seems high relative to the gains it brings.

author: 0w3n6325
content:
I would say in practice though, builders delaying the payload will not be the bottleneck. It's highly likely that timing games will continue to eat away the first few seconds of the slot. With beacon blocks gossiped close the 3 second mark.

And since the beacon block is less than 64 KB and it's validation is quick. We will most likely be in a position to release the payload before 4 seconds into the slot.
